title: Adding Details Worksheets | 1st Reading Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: L.1.1f, W.1.5

Give your learners extra practice with Adding Details! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Which Has More Detail?
  • Add a Describing Word
  • When or Where?
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Which Has More Detail?, Add a Describing Word, When or Where?), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
